title: Medium test draft: do Giphy and Streamable move by themselves?
instructions: Optional. Open your unpublished Medium draft "Embed loop test (private test, do not publish)" in preview. Answer: does the Giphy clip move and loop without a click? Does the Streamable clip? Do the Vimeo and YouTube boxes show a play button? Then delete the test draft.

result.notes: Giphy and imgur are auto-play and loop without click. no need to remove the test draft.
